business_problem: NFCU needed to replace a legacy CRM environment that forced employees to work through manual steps, disconnected systems, and complex security workflows that slowed case handling and increased compliance risk.
solution_summary: Capgemini helped Navy Federal Credit Union replace fragmented back-office and CRM processes with a unified operating model centered on a modern CRM platform and Microsoft AI Business Solutions. Legacy case handling, security checks, and research-heavy workflows were redesigned so work could move through a single environment instead of disconnected tools and manual handoffs. AI services automate classification, validation, routing, and next-best-action guidance, giving staff structured recommendations while keeping humans in control of case resolution. The implementation paired process re-engineering with technology integration so case data, workflow status, and compliance steps are handled consistently across teams. By reducing repetitive work and improving information access inside the CRM flow, NFCU created a faster, more reliable, and more compliant operating model for day-to-day back-office processing.

solution_components.name: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the single environment that unifies legacy case work, workflow status, and employee activity across back-office operations.

solution_components.name: Microsoft AI Business Solutions
solution_components.role: Automates case classification, validation, routing, and next-best-action guidance for employees handling back-office work.

data_flow: Legacy case and customer work is consolidated into a unified CRM platform, where Microsoft AI Business Solutions classify, validate, route, and guide next actions before employees complete the case inside the modernized workflow.
business_outcome: NFCU improved case closure rates by over 50%, reduced task completion times from days to hours, lowered processing errors, and strengthened regulatory compliance while improving the employee experience.
